help.title: How does the app work?
help.body: Press the microphone and recite from memory. Words appear on the page as you recite them correctly. Use ⚙️ to change your level or view your certificates.
app.updateReady: Update ready — reopen the app to apply it
ondevice.title: The recitation engine on your device
ondevice.body: To listen to your recitation and reveal each word in its place on the mushaf page, the app needs to download its listening engine once (about 130 MB). After that, reciting runs right on your device, even offline, and your recitation never leaves your phone.
ondevice.wifi: Wi-Fi is recommended. On iPhone, add this page to your Home Screen so the engine stays saved.
ondevice.error: The download failed. Check your connection and try again.
ondevice.sorry: Sorry, reciting cannot run on this device. It needs a newer phone or an up-to-date browser (Chrome or Safari).
server.privacyOnDevice: Your recitation is processed on your device only and is never sent to a server.
review.title: Today's review
review.none: Nothing due for review today. Well done!
review.mode: Reviewing page {page}: recite it from memory
review.done: Well done! Next review in {days} days
tajweed.clean: Masha Allah! No tajweed notes in {n} verse(s).
tajweed.none: Recite at least one complete verse, then check tajweed.
tajweed.error: Tajweed check failed. Please try again.
tajweed.note: Automatic, approximate guidance — not an ijazah. Recite to a qualified teacher.
guide.text: The words are hidden; each appears in its place when you recite it correctly from memory. The gold box marks the next word.
guide.cta: Tap the microphone 🎙️ and start reciting
home.engineText: Reciting runs on your device. Download the listening engine once (about 130 MB); the download resumes on its own if the connection drops.
home.engineReady: The recitation engine is ready on your device ✓
